parameters.query:
INSERT INTO leads (session_id, name, phone, email, service, urgency, is_new_patient, payment,
                   preferred_time, notes, score, tier, status, tags)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''), NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), NULLIF($5, ''), NULLIF($6, ''),
        NULLIF($7, '')::boolean, NULLIF($8, ''), NULLIF($9, ''), NULLIF($10, ''), $11, $12, $13,
        string_to_array($14, ','))
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name, phone = EXCLUDED.phone, email = EXCLUDED.email, service = EXCLUDED.service,
  urgency = EXCLUDED.urgency, is_new_patient = EXCLUDED.is_new_patient, payment = EXCLUDED.payment,
  preferred_time = EXCLUDED.preferred_time, notes = EXCLUDED.notes, score = EXCLUDED.score,
  tier = EXCLUDED.tier, status = EXCLUDED.status, tags = EXCLUDED.tags, updated_at = now()
RETURNING id

parameters.subject: ={{ $('Normalize and Score').item.json.urgency === 'emergency' ? '🚨 Emergency' : '🔥 Hot lead' }}: {{ $('Normalize and Score').item.json.name || 'New patient' }} ({{ $('Normalize and Score').item.json.service || 'service not given yet' }})
